external_comparison.py.change: The September plotting function reads lat_n, the latitude column stored in both track archives. Numerical scores and frozen weights use the sealed computation. Replacing the single line g.lat_n, with g.lat, reproduces the frozen source hash.

src/tc_emulator/tc_adapter.py.change: A finite spatial wind-grid overshoot during a FAST trial step triggers a retry of the identical disturbance with a smaller integration step cap. The successful original integration path keeps its original cap. In the six new SSP2-4.5 years only the warming-only Research case documented in midcentury/boundary_retry.json used the fallback. The 90- and 45-minute caps give identical TC and landfall classification. The pre-follow-up runtime is preserved in parent commit 01f169cfffc0dd5054fc7704c86667974f3065e6.
